errors: The table implies cookie authentication for a cross-domain API requires the API to be same-site. Cross-site cookie authentication is possible with SameSite=None; Secure and credentialed CORS, subject to browser third-party-cookie restrictions.
The table implies cookie-based authentication always requires both SameSite and a CSRF token. Appropriate SameSite protections can suffice in some designs; both are not universally required.
